Smooth positional data
---

Data dual-passed through a 4th order dual low-pass Butterworth filter
A 6 Hz cutoff was chosen because a biomechanist said that was the right thing to do.

###### Drop rough data

```{r}
# drop raw
raw_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
dt[, (raw_cols) := NULL]

# drop _smooth from smoothed
smoothed_cols <- grep("_smooth$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(dt, smoothed_cols, gsub("_smooth", "", smoothed_cols))
```

###### Translate

Origin is wherever they started.

```{r}
markers <- grep("_(x|y|z)", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

dt[, (markers) := lapply(.SD, \(axis) axis <- axis - axis[1]),
  by = .(trajectory),
  .SDcols = markers
]
```

###### Get hand position

Treating the avg to represent hand pos.

```{r}
invisible(
  lapply(
    c("x", "y", "z"),
    \(axis) {
      cols <- grep(paste0("_", axis), colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
      dt[,
        paste0("hand_", axis) := rowMeans(.SD),
        .SDcols = cols
      ]
    }
  )
)
# drop marker cols
dt[, (grep("^m\\d", colnames(dt))) := NULL]
```

For ease of visual interpretation, selectively flipping conditions so that all reaches curve
in the same direction. Currently:


|-| Lhand | Rhand |
|-|-|-|
| Fhand | to left | to right |
| Bhand | to right | to left |


```{r}
dt[, hand_x := fcase(
  hand_used == "left" & side_used == "front", hand_x * -1,
  hand_used == "right" & side_used == "back", hand_x * -1,
  default = hand_x
)]

# also make things positive
# dt[, hand_x := hand_x * -1]
```
